description.value: Moon Curser Vineyards is a boutique Osoyoos winery named after gold-rush-era smugglers who dodged moonlight on the Dewdney Trail, just shy of the US border. It specializes in rare old-world varieties like Touriga Nacional, Carménère, and Tannat — grapes seldom grown elsewhere in Canada — and has earned recognition seven times on Top Winery lists at the WineAlign National Wine Awards of Canada. Cyclists on the Crowsnest Highway (Hwy 3) will find a welcoming tasting room with vineyard and Osoyoos Lake views, plus a seated 'Smuggler's Sitting' experience on select days.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Moon Curser is an active winery/tasting room in Osoyoos on Highway 3 (the Crowsnest Highway). Phone number matches between OSM and website; address refers to the same location under two names for the same road (Crowsnest Highway = Highway 3 East). No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so those fields are null per absence-of-evidence rules.
concerns: OSM lists the street as 'Crowsnest Highway' while the website footer uses 'Highway 3 East' — these are the same road but the naming differs; address updated to match the website's more complete version including city and postal code.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, award-winning destination winery on the Crowsnest Highway cycling corridor; a natural rest stop with a tasting room and vineyard views that would appeal to touring cyclists passing through Osoyoos.
